markings/cad.note: True size, one unit = one foot. Each drawing opens as one block insert on layer P-PMARK; block geometry is a SOLID hatch with its outline on layer 0, ByBlock. Base point: the middle of an arrow's tail, or the bottom center of a word or symbol (top center for yield line triangles, which sit on the line). Caltrans blocks are traced from the 2026 Standard Plans and each matches its printed width, height and area; (R) arrows are mirror images, as the plans direct. Striping details (CT-DET) run along +X for one full repeat, base point at the start of the reference line, in marking colors. Plan-library blocks are flattened to true size and checked against their stated sizes.
